name: Should I fix drywall texture myself or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I fix drywall texture myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small nail holes or tiny gouges can often be filled with spackle and touch-up paint by a homeowner. However, professional repair is the better choice for holes larger than a few inches, water-damaged ceilings, cracks along drywall seams, or specialized finishes like knockdown and orange peel. Matching spray patterns and trowel pressure requires specialized equipment and practice; uneven DIY spray cans often leave noticeable halos or mismatched sheens that become more visible under room lighting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor nail holes work well for DIY spackle, but holes over a few inches, water damage, or sprayed patterns like knockdown look best when handled by a professional.
